first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% and activation is down 6%; simplifying onboarding directly addresses both linked declines. Two independent inherited records indicate durable improvements in completion, time-to-value, and early activation across self-serve/SMB accounts, supporting sustainable qualified revenue rather than a potentially margin-eroding reactive price response.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening/simplifying onboarding for self-serve SMB accounts. This directly addresses the current declines in onboarding completion and activation. Verified evidence shows signup simplification increased SMB qualified revenue by 4% and activation by 9%, while shortened onboarding increased completion by 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and improved 30-day retention by 3%. Guardrail on retention and qualified revenue quality is required because the SMB signup-simplification test showed a 1% 30-day retention decline and its result was not replicated outside SMB.
